# Smithsonian Institution

> > The Smithsonian Institution is the world's largest museum, education, and research complex, comprising 17 museums in Washington, D.C., including the National Air and Space Museum, National Museum of African American History and Culture, Hirshhorn Museum, and National Museum of African Art.

The Smithsonian offers free admission to all museums and provides extensive digital collections, research resources, educational programs, and conservation initiatives. Key focuses include African art preservation (including Benin Bronzes repatriation), aerospace history, American history, and contemporary art exhibitions.

## Main Museums and Institutions

- [Smithsonian Institution | Home](https://si.edu): Main homepage for Smithsonian's 17 DC museums and digital collections
- [National Museum of African Art](https://africa.si.edu): Homepage for National Museum of African Art featuring exhibitions
- [About | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/about): Overview of National Air and Space Museum with facts and collection info
- [Hirshhorn Museum and Sculpture Garden | Smithsonian](https://hirshhorn.si.edu): Hirshhorn Museum homepage featuring Basquiat x Banksy and contemporary art
- [The National Air and Space Museum is Transforming!](https://airandspace.si.edu/about/major-projects/transformation): Museum renovation project reopening galleries for 50th anniversary in 2026

## Research and Collections

- [Research | National Museum of African Art](https://africa.si.edu/research): Research resources at NMAfA including collections, conservation & archives
- [Architectural History and Historic Preservation](https://ahhp.si.edu): AHHP office managing Smithsonian's historic building preservation

## Visitor Information and Support

- [Smithsonian Office of Visitor Accessibility](https://access.si.edu): Accessibility information directory for all Smithsonian museums
- [Frequently Asked Questions | NMAAHC](https://nmaahc.si.edu/visit/frequently-asked-questions): Visitor FAQ for NMAAHC covering hours, directions, and parking info
- [FAQ's | Smithsonian Digital Volunteers](https://transcription.si.edu/FAQs): FAQ for Transcription Center volunteer crowdsourcing program

## Educational Resources and Guides

- [Separate Is Not Equal - Brown v. Board of Education](https://americanhistory.si.edu/brown/resources/teachers-guide.html): Teacher's guide for Brown v. Board exhibition with primary sources
- [Science Olympiad and GUIDE FOR USING JS9](https://chandra.si.edu/js9): JS9 tutorial guide for Chandra X-ray archive analysis and Science Olympiad
- [DDMT Video Guide: Analyzing Animal Movement](https://nationalzoo.si.edu/conservation/great-plains-science/ddmt-video-guide): Video tutorial series for DDMT animal movement tracking software

## Optional

- [About | Air and Space Quarterly](https://airandspace.si.edu/air-and-space-quarterly/about): About page for Air and Space Quarterly magazine with issue archive
